label: Request variables
description: The typed answers a requester gave to a catalog item's questions (variables), stored as one object keyed by variable key. Each answer is normalized like a field of the variable's type: dates as YYYY-MM-DD, numbers rounded to scale, choices as option IDs, people as user IDs.
usage: Place it once in the request record view, usually in a "Details" card; it renders the item's questions with their answers.
Change the questions on the catalog item, not on the request entity.
constraints: Keys must be variables of the request's catalog item; unknown keys, wrong types and missing required answers are errors on variables.<key>.
Not filterable, sortable or searchable as a whole.
Field access applies to all answers together.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Each answer is an ordinary form control with its own label.
accessibility.notes: Answers are listed as label and value pairs in view mode.

responsive: Two columns on wide cards, one column below 720 px.
